Yet the seals would also be vulnerable on Solus, stray interlopers may remove the seals. Thus, the seals would need guardians.

Andromeda drew void from the Null Space, creating four creatures upon the Null Space of Solus, one for each seal. She deemed them the four kings, the King of Clubs, King of Diamonds, King of Hearts, and King of Spades. Each king would be unique, a powerful guardian distinct from the others.

The King of Clubs was apt at manipulating the Null Space, violating the rules of physics within a sphere of influence. Performing seemingly impossible feats. To any observer the King of Clubs would seem to cast magic upon his foes.

The King of Diamonds was a being of bargains. Even as a demi-god, it could grant minor blessings and gifts. Utilizing bribery to gain followers to protect the seal, and to stave off interlopers.

The King of Hearts was a philosopher, who would gently talk the interlopers away. A battle against the King of Hearts was a battle of wits, and the creature existed predominantly in the Null Space, only forming a mild projection upon Solus.

The King of Spades was a king of blades. Physically imposing, and whirling the air into cutting implements, swirling the Null Space like the Purity Engine with a malevolent intent.

Each king would be benevolent but detached until the seal they guarded was threatened. Each king would then serve to protect the seals to the best of their abilities. Each being would be killable, but to slay one would be an arduous and difficult task.
